title: specy-road orchestration contract
description: roadmap/orchestration.yaml: who may coordinate, execute, and review leaves, and what the implementation review gate requires. A missing file means the default policy (one reviewer, any family, roster of one human).

roster.description: Models (and humans) that may hold a role. A review counts toward the gate only when its model is rostered with the reviewer role, or is the substitute in an active substitution for that node.

substitutions.description: Recorded decisions to let a named substitute fill a reviewer slot, with a date and an expiry.

id.description: Model id as used in review records (e.g. claude-opus-5.5, human).

family.description: Vendor family; reviewer independence is judged by family (e.g. anthropic, openai, human).

profile.description: Repo-relative path to this model's profile (model-profiles/<family>/<api_id>.md).

cli.description: Headless invocation; {prompt} is replaced with the prompt file path.

paste.description: Name of the IDE chat a prompt file is pasted into.

may_process.description: Data sensitivity levels this model may receive (e.g. public, internal, restricted).

subagent_family_lock.description: When set, this model may spawn only sub-agents of this family.

preflight.description: Command that must succeed before a prompt is sent to this model.

reviewers_required.description: Approving review records at the branch HEAD needed before mark-implementation-reviewed succeeds. Default 1.

reviewers_distinct_families.description: When true, the approvals must come from that many distinct families. Default false.

reviewer_fresh_session.description: When true, a review record must attest it came from a fresh session. Default true.

slot.description: The reviewer slot being filled, e.g. reviewer-openai.

scope.description: Node ids the substitution covers. Omit to cover every node.

expires_when.description: Human-readable expiry condition, e.g. 'gpt-5.6-sol has capacity'.

expires.description: Machine-checked expiry: the substitution stops counting after this date.
